notes.title: 09-04-25 BUG FIX PATCH
notes.content: [h1]09-04-25 BUG FIX PATCH[/h1][p][/p][p]AUDIO[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the secret room audio to not trigger[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the Louis audio to keep looping after the scene was over.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]VISUAL[/p][list][*][p]Changed one of the flowers' appearance to make it look more like a regular sunflower, and less like Sammy.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]OTHER[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed players to trigger Margret's second secret scene before the "game crash".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would always make Margret disappear when playing her game. Now you have to grab her face to cause this.[/p][/*][/list]
